mistake_reason: The ASEAN_CountryVerification_Expert explicitly expanded the set of countries to include Timor-Leste (capital: Dili), despite the task specifying "within the ASEAN bloc" and to use official member states and capitals as listed on Wikipedia. Timor-Leste is not a full ASEAN member as of 2024. This violated the task constraints (FM-1.1 Disobey Task Specification), causing the computation to consider a non-member capital and resulting in the incorrect final answer "Myanmar, Timor-Leste" instead of the ground truth "Indonesia, Myanmar".
